name: MVP-B — LUX Lead Follow-Up Sequence Generator

parameters.jsCode:
const lead = JSON.parse($('Build Context').item.json.lead_json);
return {
  Name: lead.name || '',
  Company: lead.company || '',
  'Project Type': lead.project_type || '',
  Source: lead.source || '',
  'Budget Range': lead.budget_range || '',
  Timeline: lead.timeline || '',
  'Original Message': lead.message || '',
  'Lead Tier': $('Build Context').item.json.lead_tier,
  'Key Detail': $('Build Context').item.json.key_detail,
  'Email 1 Subject': $json.email_1_subject,
  'Email 1 Body': $json.email_1_body,
  'Email 2 Subject': $json.email_2_subject,
  'Email 2 Body': $json.email_2_body,
  'Email 3 Subject': $json.email_3_subject,
  'Email 3 Body': $json.email_3_body,
  Status: 'New'
};
